values.note: Campspot prices every RV site type (marina waterfront, boat dock side, back row) at $30 a night for October 27-29, 2026, plus a $5 fee per stay; no-power tent sites $15. The older KBIC fee table on the Copper Country listing gives lower non-tribal rates ($21, lakefront $28) and separate tribal-member rates. Cancelling 14+ days out refunds all but $15; 7 days, half; under 7 days, nothing.

fees.source: https://www.campspot.com/ojibwa-campground-baraga-mi/site/48890 and sibling site pages for 2026-10-27..29 ('$30.00 x 2 nights', '$5.00', 'Site Total $65.00'; tent '$15.00 x 2 nights') + https://www.campspot.com/park/ojibwa-campground-baraga-mi/policies/cancellation-policy, read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.campspot.com/park/ojibwa-campground-baraga-mi (site types '30/50 Amp Marina Waterfront RV Site', '30/50 Amp Boat Dock Side', '20/30 Amp ...'; site pages list 20/30/50-Amp and Electricity but no water or sewer hook-up), read 2026-10-25. The derived water/sewer true (note prose 'water/sewer at some') rests on no operator statement: KBIC's own listing says only 'Electrical hookups and running water are available within this campground'; cleared to unknown.

values.note: Campspot sells back-in RV sites in marina waterfront, boat-dock-side and back-row types, each allowing motorhomes, trailers and fifth-wheels to 35 ft, plus a few no-power tent sites by the marina.

sites.source: https://www.campspot.com/park/ojibwa-campground-baraga-mi ('this RV park features 80 sites with electric hookups') + site pages 48889-48895 (equipment Fifth-Wheel, Motorhome, ... Van; 'Max Length Allowed 35 ft'; Back-In), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://www.campspot.com/park/ojibwa-campground-baraga-mi ('a fill and dump station'; amenities Showers, Bathrooms) + https://www.coppercountry.com/destinations/parks/ojibwa-recreation-area/ ('access to showers and toilet facilities', 'At the entrance to the campgrounds is the dump station'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Sites are now sold by the night on Campspot under the KBIC's Ojibwa Campground listing; 2027 dates were not yet bookable on 2026-10-25. The older Copper Country listing described first-come self-registration with a ranger visit; whether walk-ups are still taken is not stated.

booking.source: https://www.campspot.com/park/ojibwa-campground-baraga-mi?checkin=2026-10-27&checkout=2026-10-28 ('8 Available Sites', RV types 'Starting at $35.00 total'; June 2027 'This campground isn't taking reservations for those dates'), read 2026-10-25. Replaces the derived reservable false / fcfs always.

note: Recreation area run by the Keweenaw Bay Indian Community (tribal) on Keweenaw Bay (Lake Superior) by Sand Point Lighthouse and the marina, just N of Baraga off US-41 (RV Life mislabels as county). Two camp areas: the Lake Front (Sand Point) loop on the bay and the inland Red Pines loop; pow-wow grounds, swimming areas, playgrounds. Tribal operator bucketed as private per existing DB convention. --Claude
summary: Campspot (KBIC's 'Ojibwa Campground' listing) + its site pages and policy, with the KBIC fee table on Copper Country: fees 21-28 -> 30-30 (October 2026, + $5 per stay; the $21/$28 table is undated); booking changed from FCFS-only to reservable on Campspot (fcfs cleared to unknown); added 30/50-amp electric, RVs to 35 ft (back-in), showers; cleared derived water/sewer hookups (no operator statement); 80 sites and dump confirmed. Season (derived year-round) not stated anywhere current; left. Private gates: dated 2026 rate $30 + $5 is under the $50 gate, booking page = presence; non-members book publicly. Note dropped the facts the fields hold and the stale FCFS/price text.
flags: Website: the stored link is a coppercountry.com tourism listing; KBIC's own site (kbic-nsn.gov) has no campground page. Published name: Campspot calls it 'Ojibwa Campground'; the stored name is 'Ojibwa Recreation Area (Sand Point) Campground'.
